description: Ministry of Higher Education and Highways - Order to appoint Prof P. Gunawardhana to be the Competent Authority of Postgraduate Institute of Archeology
categorisation: This gazette names a specific individual (Professor Prishantha Gunawardhana) and outlines detailed responsibilities and powers being assigned to them as Competent Authority for the Postgraduate Institute of Archealogy, including exercising powers "in lieu of Director" and performing duties under the Universities Act. This combination of a named person with specific functional responsibilities makes it a Hybrid Gazette (Type 3).
